question: Which hormone is the main driver behind early cardiovascular changes in pregnancy?
explanation: Progesterone relaxes smooth muscle walls throughout the body, causing widespread vasodilation that triggers the heart to adapt early in pregnancy. [learn more](BMP212_U1_T4#BMP212_U1_T4_h1)

question: Why does the maternal cardiovascular system undergo such massive changes during pregnancy?

options.A: To prevent the mother from developing high blood pressure
options.B: To shrink the size of the maternal kidneys and liver
options.C: To supply enough oxygen and nutrients to the growing fetus
options.D: To prepare the mother for heavy manual labor after delivery

explanation: The entire remodeling process exists to ensure the placenta receives enough blood flow to nourish and oxygenate the baby safely. [learn more](BMP212_U1_T4#BMP212_U1_T4_h1)

question: What happens to the total blood volume of a woman by the third trimester?

options.A: It decreases slightly to save energy
options.B: It remains exactly the same as pre-pregnancy
options.C: It doubles to over 100 percent increase

explanation: Blood volume expands significantly during gestation to meet the metabolic demands of both mother and baby. [learn more](BMP212_U1_T4#BMP212_U1_T4_h2)

question: Why does physiological hemodilution occur in pregnant women?

options.A: Red blood cells are actively destroyed by the placenta
options.B: Excessive water drinking dilutes the salt in the blood
options.C: The body stops producing bone marrow cells temporarily
options.D: Plasma increases much faster than red blood cells

explanation: Because plasma volume expands much more rapidly than red blood cell mass, the blood becomes diluted, leading to a lower reading on hemoglobin tests. [learn more](BMP212_U1_T4#BMP212_U1_T4_h2)

question: Which two factors combine to increase cardiac output during pregnancy?

options.B: Plasma volume and red cell count

explanation: Cardiac output is the product of stroke volume and heart rate; both increase during pregnancy to boost overall blood flow. [learn more](BMP212_U1_T4#BMP212_U1_T4_h3)

question: A healthy pregnant woman at 32 weeks visits the clinic, and her resting pulse is noted to be slightly higher than before she was pregnant. What is the best interpretation of this finding?

options.A: It shows she has consumed too much caffeine before her appointment
options.B: It indicates that the woman is suffering from chronic severe anemia
options.C: It is an early warning sign of severe maternal heart failure
options.D: It is a normal physiological adjustment to support higher cardiac output

explanation: A modest increase in resting heart rate is expected as the body works harder to circulate the larger volume of blood. [learn more](BMP212_U1_T4#BMP212_U1_T4_h3)

question: What generally happens to systemic vascular resistance during a normal pregnancy?
explanation: Vessel walls relax and widen, causing systemic vascular resistance to drop, which keeps blood pressure lower during early and mid-pregnancy. [learn more](BMP212_U1_T4#BMP212_U1_T4_h4)

question: Why does maternal blood pressure typically fall during the second trimester?

options.A: The heart pumps with much less force than before
options.B: Red blood cells shrink to fit through narrow capillaries
options.C: Widespread relaxation of blood vessels lowers resistance
options.D: The kidneys remove excessive salt from the bloodstream

explanation: When blood vessels dilate widely, the resistance against which the heart pumps drops, leading to lower blood pressure readings. [learn more](BMP212_U1_T4#BMP212_U1_T4_h4)

question: Which large blood vessel is compressed by the uterus when a pregnant woman lies flat on her back?
explanation: The heavy uterus presses directly on the inferior vena cava in the supine position, blocking blood flow back to the heart. [learn more](BMP212_U1_T4#BMP212_U1_T4_h5)

question: A woman at 36 weeks gestation complains of feeling dizzy and faint while resting flat on her examination bed. What immediate action should the midwife take?

options.A: Turn her onto her left lateral side
options.B: Encourage her to stand up and walk around
options.C: Check her fasting blood glucose level

explanation: Turning the woman onto her side relieves pressure off the inferior vena cava, instantly restoring venous return and relieving symptoms. [learn more](BMP212_U1_T4#BMP212_U1_T4_h5)

question: What type of heart murmur is considered a normal finding in the majority of healthy pregnant women?
explanation: Increased blood flow velocity creates mild turbulence, resulting in a benign soft systolic murmur heard in many normal pregnancies. [learn more](BMP212_U1_T4#BMP212_U1_T4_h6)

question: Which of the following cardiovascular findings during antenatal auscultation requires immediate investigation and referral?
explanation: Diastolic murmurs are almost always pathological in pregnancy and signal underlying structural heart disease that needs specialist review. [learn more](BMP212_U1_T4#BMP212_U1_T4_h6)
